goalZh: 会用 turn it on、plug it in 这类短语动词一步步说怎么开机、连网、登录
canDoZh: 能一步步告诉别人怎么开机、连网和登录,用对 turn it on 这类说法

newItems.noteZh: 第 1 单元学过 computer science;笔记本电脑口语也常说 computer。重音在中间 com-PU-ter,t 读闪音。
Is it plugged in? 插上电了吗?;代词放中间:plug it in,连读成“plu-gi-tin”。
turn on the computer = turn the computer on;代词只能放中间:turn it on,不说 turn on it。
和 turn on 相反;turn it off 连读成“tur-ni-toff”。
log in with your email 用邮箱登录;登录某个网站说 log in to…;名词写成一个词 login。
用完公用电脑一定要 log out;连读成“lo-gout”。
set up a new computer 把新电脑设置好;代词放中间:set it up,t 在元音前读闪音“se-dup”。
type your password 输入密码;y 读 /aɪ/,词尾 p 收住。

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: Lei, can you help me? My new computer doesn't work.
lines.zh: (索菲亚抱着新买的电脑来找学计算机的磊)磊,能帮帮我吗?我的新电脑开不了机。

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: Plugged in? Oh… no, it isn't.

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: OK. Plug it in. Now turn it on.

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Let's set it up. First, turn on the Wi-Fi.
lines.zh: 我们先把它设置好。第一步,打开 Wi-Fi。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Then log in with your student email.
lines.zh: 然后用你的学生邮箱登录。

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: OK. I'm typing my password… I'm in! You're a good teacher!
lines.zh: 好。我在输密码……登进去了!你真是个好老师!

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: Do I turn it off at night?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Yes, turn it off. And log out on library computers, OK?
lines.zh: (磊有点不好意思)要,关掉吧。还有,在图书馆的电脑上用完要退出登录,好吗?

questions.prompt: 索菲亚的电脑为什么开不了机?
questions.explainZh: 磊问 Is it plugged in?,索菲亚说 no, it isn't.(没插电)。
磊说 Then log in with your student email.。

questions.prompt: 磊提醒她在图书馆的电脑上要做什么?
questions.explainZh: 磊说 And log out on library computers, OK?

grammar.titleZh: 短语动词:turn it on,不说 turn on it
grammar.bodyZh: turn on(打开)、turn off(关掉)、plug in(插上电)、set up(设置好)都是“动词 + 小词”组成的短语动词。宾语是名词时,放中间或后面都可以:turn on the computer = turn the computer on;宾语是代词(it、them)时,只能放中间:turn it on、plug it in、set it up,不说 turn on it。这和第 6 单元的 try it on 是同一个规则。log in / log out(登录 / 退出)后面一般不直接跟宾语:登录某处用 log in to…,用什么登录用 with:log in with your student email。发音:代词放中间时连读,turn it on 读成“tur-ni-ton”,plug it in 读成“plu-gi-tin”。

examples.text: Plug it in. Now turn it on.
Turn on the Wi-Fi. = Turn the Wi-Fi on.
Log in with your student email.

grammar.titleZh: 教别人操作:祈使句 + First / Then
grammar.bodyZh: 教别人一步步操作,直接用动词原形开头的祈使句:Plug it in. Turn it on. Log in.;用 First,(第一步)、Then,(然后)把步骤串起来(第 8 单元学过)。确认对方做到哪一步,可以问 Is it plugged in? / Is it on?;对方做好了常说 It's on!(开了!)、I'm in!(我登进去了!)。提醒别人注意的事也用祈使句:Turn it off at night. / Log out on library computers.。

examples.text: First, turn on the Wi-Fi. Then log in.
Is it plugged in? — No, it isn't.
